NoGameBanner.title: FFXIV not detected!
NoGameBanner.body: XIVDeck was not able to detect a running copy of FFXIV. Please make sure you have launched the game through <launcher>XIVLauncher</launcher> and that you've installed the XIVDeck plugin in-game.
NoGameBanner.help: If this problem persists, visit the <discord>Dalamud Discord</discord> for help.

GameDisconnectedBanner.title: Couldn't connect to XIVDeck server!
GameDisconnectedBanner.body: XIVDeck detected a running copy of FFXIV, but couldn't establish a connection to the XIVDeck plugin. Please make sure you have launched the game through <launcher>XIVLauncher</launcher> and that you've installed the XIVDeck plugin in-game.
GameDisconnectedBanner.help: If this problem persists, visit the <discord>Dalamud Discord</discord> for help.

help.title: Classes Help
help.body: When this button is pressed, XIVDeck will switch to the first gearset matching the selected class. Classes without a gearset will not be displayed or usable.
